privacyNotice.title: Privacy Notice
privacyNotice.intro: This notice explains, in general terms, how your personal data is handled when you make a reservation. It is provided by the restaurant you are booking with, using this platform.
privacyNotice.controllerTitle: Who is responsible for your data
privacyNotice.controllerBody: The restaurant you are booking with is the data controller for the information you submit. This platform acts only as a data processor, handling your data on the restaurant's behalf and instructions.
privacyNotice.whatBody: Typically: your name, phone number, and (if provided) email address, along with reservation details such as date, time, and party size.
privacyNotice.whyBody: To create, confirm, and manage your reservation, to contact you about it (e.g. confirmations, reminders, or changes), and — only if you separately opt in — to send you marketing messages.
privacyNotice.howLongBody: Your data is kept for as long as needed to fulfill the reservation and for a limited retention period afterward, after which it is anonymized or deleted.
privacyNotice.whoWithBody: Your data is shared only with service providers that help operate this platform and deliver reservation-related messages (e.g. SMS/WhatsApp delivery), and is not sold or shared for unrelated purposes.
privacyNotice.rightsBody: You may contact the restaurant directly to request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data.
privacyNotice.tenantOverrideNote: This restaurant has provided its own notice below.

privacyExplain.OWN_ONLY: Each staff member sees only their own assigned shifts on the schedule — they cannot see who else is working.
privacyExplain.SHIFT_TEAM: Staff see their own shifts plus the teammates working the same shift that day, but not the full roster.
privacyExplain.FULL_ROSTER: Every staff member can see the complete roster for all colleagues and shifts.

logicExplain.DYNAMIC_DURATION: A booking's end time is calculated automatically from the default duration set above (e.g. 90 minutes after the start time).
logicExplain.FIXED_SLOTS: Bookings use fixed, pre-defined time slots. Each reservation occupies the table for the default duration set above, starting from the slot's time.
logicExplain.MANUAL_AVAILABILITY: No automatic time-based conflict checking. A table only blocks new bookings while staff mark it Occupied on the Tables page — clearing it (marking it Available again) is what frees it up for the next booking, not the clock.
